auxiliary_rulebase_mechanism: All auxiliary rulebases in this corpus are pulled in with an 'include=' directive, not with a cross-file custom '@type' reference. Zero cases reference a custom type defined in another file, so the cross-file type resolution path is UNCOVERED by the upstream corpus.
motif_coverage_note: Counted as cases-containing-motif across both rulebase syntaxes: the JSON form ("type":"x") and the %name:type% shorthand. An earlier count that read only the JSON form undercounted badly - cisco-interface-spec appeared as 0 when it is 6.
